content.tagline: Science-based cosmetic scalp and hair care
content.descriptor: Korean biotech company: HAIRREGEON and HERIBON brands
about: CK Regeon Inc. is a Korean biotech company founded in 2016 in Seoul (Yonsei Engineering Research Park). The company is led by Professor Kang-Yell Choi, a researcher of the Wnt signaling pathway with more than twenty years of scientific experience. The company's cosmetics brand portfolio is united under the name DermaRegeon.

Products are built around the company's proprietary "WNT ON" technology: the components KY19382 and hesperidin, along with the PTD-DBM peptide, aimed at modulating the Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway via the CXXC5 protein. The mechanism is described in peer-reviewed publications — Journal of Investigative Dermatology (2017) and British Journal of Pharmacology (2021).

Important for accurate communication: the published research is preclinical in nature (cell cultures, ex vivo, and animal models) and describes the mechanism of action of the components, not proven clinical efficacy of finished products. The products are positioned as cosmetic scalp and hair care.

lines.name: HAIRREGEON
lines.note: A professional intensive scalp care line. The flagship product is the PTD-DBM Hair Booster: a two-component set (lyophilized powder and solvent), packaged in boxes of five sets.

lines.name: HERIBON
lines.note: A daily home-care line, "WNT ON," in four steps: shampoo (500 ml), scalp scaler (300 ml), hair care mask (250 ml), and scalp tonic (50 ml).

tech.name: "WNT ON" technology
tech.note: The company's proprietary development based on the components KY19382 and hesperidin, aimed at modulating the Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway via the CXXC5 protein.

tech.name: PTD-DBM peptide
tech.note: A component of the professional HAIRREGEON line. Its competitive CXXC5-binding mechanism is described in a Journal of Investigative Dermatology (2017) publication at the preclinical level.

tech.name: Scientific foundation
tech.note: Mechanism studies are published in peer-reviewed journals: Journal of Investigative Dermatology (2017) and British Journal of Pharmacology (2021). The work was performed on cell cultures, ex vivo, and animal models.

content.exportNote: The company is building international distribution for its cosmetics brands, launched in 2025, and takes part in industry trade shows in Asia. Territories, current distributors, and market-specific terms are clarified at the deal stage through Teranova.

terms.label: Cooperation formats
terms.value: Wholesale supply of finished HAIRREGEON and HERIBON branded products.

terms.label: Minimum order
terms.value: HAIRREGEON — from 5 sets. HERIBON — in multiples of the pack size per item (shampoo from 20 units, scaler and mask from 25 units, tonic from 100 units).

terms.label: Pricing
terms.value: Indicative wholesale range; HERIBON on EXW/FOB Korea terms for orders from 10,000 USD, HAIRREGEON on FCA terms. Exact prices on request.
